title: Budget Narrative Attachment Form
notes: This form collects budget narrative attachments for its own purpose. It shares the existing UUID-list answer shape with other attachment forms; matching structure does not make their questions interchangeable.

The DAT separates a mandatory first-file control (1-0) and an optional additional-files control (2-0). The proposed single ordered list preserves at least one and at most 100 file references, consistent with the pinned existing SGG schema and XSD. The four DAT differences remain explicit for review; they are not an approved source waiver.

Each item is an attachment UUID. Examples contain synthetic identifiers, not actual uploads; no filename, MIME type, file content, user ownership, download, storage or XML descriptor is represented by these values.

The plan does not add an upload service, alter API integration, or design attachment XML. The existing SGG attachment validation and file-to-XML handling are reference observations; production integration remains separate.

Agency instructions determine document content and ordering. Preserve the separate narrative purpose and the submitted order; do not invent uniqueness, naming or content rules absent from these sources.
risks: Confirm the proposed consolidation of mandatory and additional DAT controls into one ordered list. No reviewer acceptance has been recorded.
Valid UUID syntax and array bounds do not verify file existence, ownership, accepted file types, transport or submission. Those checks belong to the existing integration boundary.
No fresh runtime, upload, XML or production parity is claimed for this plans-only package.
